title: Cambridge professor Jason Arday resigns amid accusations of plagiarism

paragraphs.en: Jason Arday, the Cambridge professor accused of plagiarism and embellishment, has resigned after the university announced he was to face new investigations into his qualifications and career.
paragraphs.zh: 被指控抄袭和夸大履历的剑桥大学教授杰森·阿德雷（Jason Arday），在剑桥大学宣布将对其资历和职业生涯展开新调查后，已经辞职。

paragraphs.en: Arday, who had been dogged by a growing series of questions over his academic work and credentials, issued a statement on Wednesday night, saying the “relentless accusations, speculation and public commentary have taken a profound toll on me and on those I love”.
paragraphs.zh: 阿德雷一直因围绕其学术成果和资历的越来越多质疑而备受困扰。他于周三晚间发表声明，称“无休止的指控、猜测和公开评论，对我以及我所爱的人造成了深重的伤害”。

paragraphs.en: In the statement, published on the Good Law Project website, he wrote: “It is with profound sadness that I write to resign, with immediate effect, from my position at the University of Cambridge and Jesus College.
paragraphs.zh: 这份发布在 Good Law Project 网站上的声明写道：“我怀着深深的悲痛写下这份辞呈，即日辞去我在剑桥大学和耶稣学院（Jesus College）的职务。”

paragraphs.en: “When I accepted the extraordinary honour of becoming professor of sociology at Cambridge, it was, without question, the greatest professional privilege of my life.”
paragraphs.zh: “当我接受成为剑桥大学社会学教授这份殊荣时，毫无疑问，那是我一生中最大的职业荣耀。”

paragraphs.en: Related: Playbooks, plagiarism and a pig’s head: new claims surrounding a star Cambridge professor
paragraphs.zh: 相关报道：战术手册、抄袭和一颗猪头：围绕一位明星剑桥教授的新指控

paragraphs.en: However, after days of detailed scrutiny of his previous work and statements highlighting apparent discrepancies, Arday said he had “concluded that the only way to bring this chapter to an end is to step away”.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，在对他过往工作和陈述进行了多日的详细审查并暴露出明显出入之后，阿德雷表示，他“得出结论，唯一能让这一篇章落幕的方式就是离开”。

paragraphs.en: Simon & Schuster had been preparing to publish Arday’s memoir, entitled Great and Unfortunate Things, later this month. His resignation may pause or even halt its publication and planned publicity tours.
paragraphs.zh: 西蒙与舒斯特（Simon & Schuster）出版公司原本准备于本月晚些时候出版阿德雷的回忆录《伟大而不幸之事》（Great and Unfortunate Things）。他的辞职可能会暂停甚至终止该书的出版以及原定的宣传巡回活动。

paragraphs.en: Cambridge had initially defended Arday – the youngest black professor appointed in the university’s history, with a compelling life story of educational disadvantage – as “the victim of a vile campaign”. But as questions multiplied over Arday’s own claims, the university’s leaders felt that Cambridge’s reputation was in danger.
paragraphs.zh: 剑桥最初曾为阿德雷辩护——他是该校历史上获聘的最年轻的非裔教授，有着令人动容的、出身教育弱势环境的人生故事——称他是“一场卑劣运动的受害者”。但随着围绕阿德雷本人说法的质疑不断增加，剑桥的领导层感到学校的声誉面临危险。
